question_evidence_quote: For every green tractor he sells, he gets paid 20% of the sales price for each tractor.
observed_error: The response labels the $1,000 commission per green tractor as its price.
violated_condition: The commission per green tractor equals 20% of its full sales price.
error_description: The response correctly divides $3,000 in green-tractor earnings by three, but labels the resulting $1,000 as the price per tractor instead of the commission. It then multiplies by 1.20, although the commission equals 20% of the full price and must be divided by 0.20.
